chapter: Rising in Manhattan: clubs, Hilda and the Latin scene
title: Meeting Hilda at the Park Plaza
summary: After a Stork Club conga-line fundraiser, Machito met Hilda at the Park Plaza and bought her a Coca-Cola.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Okay, let's not get ahead or ourselves. There came a time when you signed a contract with Decca. They heard you, right? They heard you at the Park [Plaza]
All right, and then the historians that are going to hear this and probably read this, want to know how you met Hilda.
Well, so I went to a - to raising funds for
some kind of charity, you know, how the Rockefeller family was ......

At the Stork Club. In those days, the Conga was very popular, especially for the higher-up people. So I borrowed a conga from one of my musicians and I went up there and make a conga line and collect about thirty-thousand dollars, So I - he gave me a hundred dollars. In those days one hundred dollars was a lot of money. - so I got my conga and come back to the Park Plaza and she happened to be out there - because she was accompanying a friend that the mother wouldn't allow her to go places that wasn't accompanied by Hilda, because, you know - so she was talking with one of my saxophone players, So I invited them to have a drink so we went to the bar, asked for Coca-Cola. She asked for Coca-Cola and me for Coca-Cola.
